meta.title: Superagent WSL local adapter
meta.description: Experimental Windows Host / selected-user WSL adaptation for DSH 0.2.2-rc.3. One self-contained bundle provides runtime, client, managed workspace files, instructions and skills. The source package starts disabled; machine bundles enable only the runtime, not GitHub polling or processing. Configure and confirm account identity and allowed repositories before use. Feishu and WSL subagent/workflow delegation are not enabled. See the bundled WSL-ADAPTER document for verification limits.
